versions.changelog:
- Initial release of hiapi-happyhorse-1-0-video skill.
- Enables text-to-video generation using the HappyHorse 1.0 model via HiAPI.
- Supports video durations from 3 to 15 seconds, resolutions of 720p and 1080p, and multiple aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4).
- Includes robust error guidance for common configuration and API issues.
- Requires Node.js 18+ and HIAPI_API_KEY environment variable.
